title: Secrets defense, custom rules, module wiring, seam audit

files_reviewed.seam: B — OK; case-sensitive platform-key finding (B1-H3) applies here too
F — From<CustomPiiSeverity> for PiiSeverity is in config but belongs in pii (smell, not defect)
G — independent of src/pii, no issues

findings.title: Bearer pattern is case-sensitive; `bearer`/`BEARER` headers are missed (RFC 7235 says case-insensitive)
Missing high-impact API-key families: AWS Secret, Google (AIza), GitLab PAT, Stripe live, HuggingFace, Linear, npm, Perplexity, OpenRouter
Slack xoxe- (Enterprise) not covered — current regex is xox[bpras]
SSH-key regex does not require BEGIN/END labels to match; malformed PEM bundles are partially accepted
No checksum on ghp_/github_pat_ — heuristic only; documented design, not a fix
Non-greedy .*? picks the first END after a BEGIN; concatenated multi-key bundles may behave unexpectedly
Custom rule compile failures are warn-logged and silently dropped; no startup self-check reports inactive rules
All 7 built-in rule objects constructed on every reload — design is OK (OnceLock caches regex), recorded for completeness
Inline regex comments depend on (?x) extended mode; no guard test
PiiMatch.rule_name/placeholder clones on every match — requires PiiMatch → Cow<str> refactor (out of scope)
build_rules returns Vec<Box<dyn PiiRule>>; metadata-only callers can't avoid detect() — minor
From<CustomPiiSeverity> for crate::pii::engine::PiiSeverity crosses config→pii boundary; belongs in src/pii (seam smell)
